nights.title: Freya Skye - Stars Align Tour
nights.name: Freya Skye
nights.extract: Freya Skye is an English singer and actress. She represented the United Kingdom in the Junior Eurovision Song Contest 2022, after which she was signed to Hollywood Records. Skye also has a talent holding deal for projects with Disney Branded Television. As an actress, she has appeared in The Next Step and made her film debut starring as Nova Bright in Zombies 4: Dawn of the Vampires. As a musician, Skye has released a number of singles since 2020 and released her debut extended play Stardust in 2026 and embarked on her first headlining tour, the Stars Align Tour.
